2 Games in 1 - The SpongeBob SquarePants.name: 2 Games In 1: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie + SpongeBob SquarePants and Friends in Freeze Frame Frenzy

Fire Pro Wrestling A.name: Fire Pro Wrestling
Fire Pro Wrestling A.summary: Step into the Fire Pro Wrestling ring and experience blistering hot wrestling action that will blow you away! Extreme Wrestlers. Masked Luchadores. Martial Artists. Ultimate Fighters. They're all here and they all have one mission--win at any cost. Chose Slams. Flying Backbreakers. Pile Drivers. Skull Crushers. No move is too extreme and nothing is illegal unless you get caught!

Teen Titans 2.name: Teen Titans 2
Teen Titans 2.summary: Teen Titans 2 (alternatively known as Teen Titans 2: The Brotherhood's Revenge on the title screen) is a Game Boy Advance game released in 2006, one year after the previous Teen Titans Game Boy Advance game and the same year as the Teen Titans video game for the PlayStation 2, Xbox, and Nintendo GameCube.
